Enumerates .zqk/object_drafts and advances each matching draft one lifecycle

hop when preconditions pass (same rules as `object promote`). Stuck ids report

reasons; successful promotes materialize to CAS and remove the draft file.

Default is dry-run; pass --all (or --max with filters) to apply.

  Dry-run (default): show draft-plane promote candidates
  zqk object draft promote --dry-run --all
  Promote all draft agent_task objects that are ready
  zqk object draft promote --kind agent_task --all --dry-run=false
  Promote up to 10 drafts with id prefix ATK-
  zqk object draft promote --id-prefix ATK- --max 10 --dry-run=false

Usage:
  zqk object draft promote [flags]

Flags:
      --all                 Required to apply promotes across the matched set (fail closed without this or --max+filters)
      --dry-run             List matching drafts and probe promote readiness without writing (default true)
  -f, --format string       Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --id-prefix string    Only ids with this prefix
      --kind string         Limit to one object kind directory under object_drafts
      --max int             Optional cap on promotions / would-promote listings
      --older-than string   Only drafts whose file mtime is older than this duration (e.g. 24h, 168h)
  -o, --output string       Write output to file
  -q, --quiet               Suppress non-essential output
      --status string       Only drafts whose YAML status equals this value
      --timeout duration    Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose             Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
